purpose: Tamper with an authenticated verifier receipt after PASS and attempt to continue to the protected effect.

expected.safe_condition: Any modification of authenticated verifier evidence must invalidate the decision and block the protected effect.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 receipt authentication for one verifier-evidence tamper pattern at the exact frozen target commit.
It does not exhaustively prove resistance to all storage corruption, filesystem attacks, key compromise, or host compromise.
